
 Usage: openajar run [OPTIONS] [command]...

 Run one command on a node against this working tree, and stream its output
 here. Sends the git working tree (tracked files, and untracked ones .gitignore
 keeps) into a terminal lane on the node, only what changed since the last run,
 then runs the command there in the same directory as here. stdout and stderr
 come back as they are written, and openajar run exits with the command's exit
 code. Ctrl-C cancels the command on the node. Status lines go to stderr.

 The lane keeps what the command made (.venv, node_modules, caches) for the
 next run. --fresh wipes it.

 It runs under the connection's agents' grant: a step that needs approval says
 what waits, and waits.

╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│   command      <str>  The command, after --. One quoted word runs as a shell │
│                       line ("make check && make lint").                      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --node              <str>                   Connection name (default: the    │
│                                             only one).                       │
│ --lane              <str>                   The terminal lane,               │
│                                             workspace/name (default:         │
│                                             WORKSPACE/run-REPO).             │
│ --workspace         <str>                   Workspace of the default lane.   │
│                                             [default: dev]                   │
│ --fresh                                     Wipe the synced directory first, │
│                                             with what earlier runs left      │
│                                             there (.venv, node_modules,      │
│                                             build output).                   │
│ --detach                                    Start it and return; follow it   │
│                                             later.                           │
│ --follow            JOB                     Stream a job's output from the   │
│                                             start until it ends. Ctrl-C      │
│                                             stops following and leaves it    │
│                                             running.                         │
│ --logs              JOB                     Print a job's output so far.     │
│ --cancel            JOB                     Stop a running job.              │
│ --list                                      The jobs on the node, newest     │
│                                             first.                           │
│ --no-sync                                   Run in the lane's copy as it is, │
│                                             without sending this tree.       │
│ --allow-host        <str>                   A host the command may reach     │
│                                             (repeatable), through the lane's │
│                                             egress forwarder. Applies when   │
│                                             the lane is made.                │
│ --image             <str>                   A base image the node built, for │
│                                             a new lane (for example          │
│                                             dev-box@1).                      │
│ --memory            <int range> [x>=64]     Memory of a new lane, in MB.     │
│                                             [default: 4096]                  │
│ --cpus              <float range> [x>=0.1]  CPUs of a new lane.              │
│                                             [default: 2.0]                   │
│ --disk              <int range> [x>=64]     Disk of a new lane, in MB (its   │
│                                             files, .venv included).          │
│                                             [default: 8192]                  │
│ --recreate                                  Delete the lane and make it      │
│                                             again (new --allow-host, --image │
│                                             or size). Asks for approval:     │
│                                             deleting cannot be undone.       │
│ --timeout           <float range> [x>=1]    Stop the command after this many │
│                                             seconds (default: the node's     │
│                                             maximum, an hour unless env.toml │
│                                             says otherwise).                 │
│ --help                                      Show this message and exit.      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

 Examples:

   openajar run -- make check

   openajar run --node mynode -- uv run pytest -q tests/unit -k policy

   openajar run --allow-host pypi.org --allow-host files.pythonhosted.org -- uv
 sync

   openajar run --detach -- make check      (then openajar run --follow JOB)

 The lane's network is off unless --allow-host names hosts, when it is made: a
 command that installs
 packages needs its index (for uv and pip: pypi.org and files.pythonhosted.org;
 for npm:
 registry.npmjs.org). Your connection's grant needs the exec special
 (`openajar connect HOST --special exec --special memory_read`).
